result_text:
`all_files.zip` is now built from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer stops it or `git-history.zip` from being written. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or a renamed-aspect export, so the fix itself is unchecked.

In `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, the export no longer uses five fixed file names. It now loops over the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects, in that order. For each one it gets the file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same helper that wrote the loose `aspect_<name>.txt` files, so the name it looks up always matches what was written. The zip entries use those same names.

With the default config the entries are the same as before. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`.

`LandscapeAnalyzer.java` (lines 280–284 in `codeanalyzer`) also reads these files by fixed names such as `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`. I left it alone because it wasn't part of the task, but a renamed aspect will probably break it the same way.
